caption: The drawing shows two blue ribbons made of a textured, possibly velvet-looking material, lying flat on a light beige background. Both ribbons are long and rectangular, with one ribbon arranged in a straight line and the other arranged in a loose bow with two ends hanging down. The ends of each ribbon feature intricate silver or white beaded embroidery, forming symmetrical decorative patterns, including small crosses and an edge of rounded embellishments. The embroidered sections are at one end of the straight ribbon and on both ends of the hanging parts of the bow. The rest of the ribbon is plain blue without additional decoration. The artist's name, "VERNA TALLMAN," is written in small, uppercase letters in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Man's Beaded Taffeta Necktie
